name: steering-pack
title: Integration steering pack
for_each: select id,name from acquisitions order by name

sections.title: Day-one readiness
sections.sql: select name,workstream,owner,due_date,status,blockers from task_board where acquisition_id=$1 and day_one order by due_date

sections.title: Workstream delivery
sections.sql: select name,workstream,owner,due_date,status,blockers,days_overdue from task_board where acquisition_id=$1 order by due_date

sections.title: Value delivery
sections.note: Amounts stay in each acquisition currency. Missing actuals are unknown, not zero. Accepted totals contain reviewed amounts with completed dependencies.
sections.sql: select currency,period,planned_net_cents,reported_net_cents,accepted_net_cents,variance_cents,missing_actuals,held_actuals from benefit_summary where acquisition_id=$1 order by period

sections.title: Risks and decisions
sections.sql: select name,owner,severity,due_date,status,resolution from risks where acquisition_id=$1 order by due_date

sections.title: Review notes
sections.sql: select body,actor,created_at from notes where acquisition_id=$1 order by created_at

name: benefit-review
title: Benefit evidence review
for_each: select id,name from acquisitions order by name

sections.title: Recorded claims
sections.sql: select initiative,kind,currency,period,planned_cents,actual_cents,evidence,recorded_by,reviewed_by,accepted from benefit_detail where acquisition_id=$1 order by period,initiative
